intro:
Nano Banana Pro is Lovart's flagship AI image generation model — purpose-built for professional design output, not just pretty pictures. Unlike general-purpose image generators like Midjourney or DALL-E that produce visually appealing but editorially useless images, Nano Banana Pro generates design-ready output with correct typography, proper composition, and production-quality resolution. It's the engine behind Lovart's AI Design Agent, optimized for commercial design workflows rather than artistic experimentation.

What makes Nano Banana Pro fundamentally different from every other AI image model? Two things.

First, integration. Nano Banana Pro isn't a standalone image generator where you type a prompt, get an image, and hope it works for your project. It's embedded in Lovart's complete design workflow. You generate a design. You refine specific elements with Touch Edit — tap the headline, the background, the color, and describe the change. You apply your Brand Kit for automatic color and font consistency. You export in professional formats: PNG, SVG, PDF with bleed and CMYK, PSD with layers. One platform, end to end.

Second, training. Nano Banana Pro is trained specifically on design principles — typography hierarchy, color theory, composition balance, brand consistency, print production requirements. A general-purpose model learns to make images that look good in a gallery. Nano Banana Pro learns to make designs that work in the real world: on billboards, product packaging, social media feeds, Amazon listings, and client presentations.

For the 94% of Lovart users who are not professional designers, this distinction is everything. Midjourney gives you a beautiful image that you can't edit, can't brand, and can't reliably add text to. Nano Banana Pro gives you a professional design asset that you can refine, brand, and export — all without learning a single design tool.

For content creators, social media managers, and brands producing short-form video, Kling AI is often the best choice when the content needs to feel energetic and engaging rather than slow and contemplative. Fitness content, fashion lookbooks, travel montages, event highlights, action demonstrations — these are Kling's sweet spot. steps.title: Upload your source image
steps.body: Start with any image. AI uses it as structural reference: composition, subject placement, proportions. Higher quality sources produce better transformations.

steps.title: Describe the transformation
steps.body: Tell AI what to change: style transformation, color variations, element modifications, complete reimagination while preserving structure.

steps.title: Adjust transformation strength
steps.body: Subtle (minor tweaks), balanced (preserves structure, changes style), creative (loose inspiration). Different use cases need different strengths.

steps.title: Refine and export
steps.body: Touch Edit specific areas. Export at resolution up to 4K on Professional plan.

use_cases.title: Product Variation Generation
use_cases.body: One product photo → every color variant. Show all options without photographing each one.

use_cases.title: Style Transformation
use_cases.body: Photo to watercolor, oil painting, pencil sketch, 3D render, pixel art, vector illustration. Different contexts, different aesthetics.

use_cases.title: Design Iteration
use_cases.body: Logo variations, interior design styles, fashion renderings. Explore creative directions from one starting point.

faq: Vs text-to-image?
Img2img uses source as structural guide. More controlled and predictable than building from scratch.
Will output look realistic?
Depends on intent. Photorealistic aims for realism. Watercolor aims for artistic style. AI matches description.
Transform only part?
Yes. Touch Edit for specific areas. Change one object, modify background, add/remove elements.
Max resolution?
Free: standard. Starter: HD. Professional: up to 4K. Matches source up to plan limit.
